item.title: Man hospitalized after being struck by a vehicle in Peoria; police looking for driver
item.description: Peoria police are investigating a hit-and-run after a 36-year-old man was hit by an unknown vehicle and taken to the hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.

item.title: IDOT explains why Illinois bridges have certain colors
item.description: The Illinois Department of Transportation uses four basic colors for its bridges - blue, green, gray and brown - due to their availability and the fact that they represent sky, grass, clouds and earth, with local IDOT districts making the final decision on which color to use.

item.title: Former Peoria pastor appears in court; pleads not guilty and released pending trial
item.description: Michael S. Ritchason, 48, of Pekin, has been released on bail pending trial for allegedly sending inappropriate pictures to a boy through Snapchat last summer.

item.title: Local resale shop gives blankets and teddy bears to kids in need
item.description: Helping Hands Resale Shoppe in Canton donated children's blankets, quilts and teddy bears to help comfort children in need after tragic events, in memory of Sawyer Brooks-Kirkpatrick, 4, and his grandmother Margie Brooks, 69, who died in a house fire.

item.title: Washington home suffers extensive damage after fire
item.description: The East Peoria Fire Department responded to a house fire near Silver Creek Drive and Savannah Lane on Thursday, causing extensive damage to the home and no injuries were reported.

item.title: Eureka-Goodfield EMS leads with blood on board ambulances
item.description: Eureka and Goodfield EMS is the first division in Illinois to have blood on board ambulances for pre-hospital care, potentially saving lives before reaching the hospital.

item.title: Ropp Jersey Cheese to close after 20 years in business
item.description: The six-generation Ropp family farm is closing its Ropp Jersey Cheese business on February 7, 2026, after 20 years of offering over 30 kinds of cheese profiles to customers in a 100-mile radius of Bloomington-Normal.

item.title: Pekin Mayor makes annual State of City address; focuses on future data center
item.description: Pekin Mayor Mary Burress discussed the possibility of a data center and a three-year marketing campaign to rebrand the city as a desirable place to live, work, and visit in her state of the city address.

item.title: UPDATE: A man is dead after a car hit the back of a semi near El Paso
item.description: Southbound lanes of Interstate 39 between El Paso and Minonk are closed due to a semi and passenger car wreck, and are expected to remain closed for several hours.

item.title: Peoria school bus involved in head-on collision, no kids hurt
item.description: A man was sent to the hospital with minor injuries after crashing into a Peoria school bus, while 38 kids on the bus were unharmed.
